title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
description: Ten documented Bearcat gameday and campus-spirit traditions, drawn from UC’s admissions, alumni, and band sources.

cards.title: Learn Down the Drive
cards.subtitle: Bearcat spirit tradition
cards.notes: Watch UC’s official demonstration, then join the movement only where event organizers invite participation.
cards.short_summary: A UC admissions page calls Down the Drive one of the community’s cherished Bearcats traditions.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Admissions identifies Down the Drive as a cherished Bearcats tradition and provides an official instructional video.
cards.access_notes: UC provides a video and social-media audio for learning the tradition; check event guidance before participating.

cards.title: Wear Black at a “Wear Black” Game
cards.subtitle: Nippert Stadium football tradition
cards.notes: For a designated wear-black game, dress in black and follow the current game’s official color instructions.
cards.short_summary: UC’s student-alumni guide documents dressing in all black for special football games.
cards.evidence_claim: The UC Student Alumni Council’s Red & Black Book describes dressing in all black as a tradition highlighted during special wear-black games.
cards.source_title: The Red and Black Book — University of Cincinnati Student Alumni Council
cards.access_notes: Applies to specially designated football games; confirm the current game’s theme through UC Athletics or university channels.

cards.title: Make Room for the Band’s Step Rush
cards.subtitle: Nippert Stadium pregame
cards.notes: Use the marked routes and give the musicians space as the band descends into its pregame entrance.
cards.short_summary: The marching band’s rush down the Nippert steps is a documented pregame tradition.
cards.evidence_claim: UC’s Red & Black Book says the Bearcat Marching Band rushes down the steps once the student section is filled.
cards.source_title: The Red and Black Book — University of Cincinnati Student Alumni Council
cards.access_notes: Pregame at Nippert Stadium; spectators should follow staff directions and keep clear of the band’s route.

cards.title: Time the N-A-T-I Shout
cards.subtitle: Football kickoff call-and-response
cards.notes: Listen for the kickoff and join the N-A-T-I shout before the first ball is caught, if you choose to participate.
cards.short_summary: Fans use a spelled-out N-A-T-I shout at the opening of a football kickoff.
cards.evidence_claim: UC’s Red & Black Book states that students and fans shout “N-A-T-I” before the first ball is caught after kickoff.
cards.source_title: The Red and Black Book — University of Cincinnati Student Alumni Council
cards.access_notes: Occurs during football games; follow stadium policies and announcements.

cards.title: Count the ROTC Score Push-Ups
cards.subtitle: Football scoring tradition
cards.notes: After a Bearcats score, watch the cadets’ push-up count and cheer from your seat or designated viewing area.
cards.short_summary: ROTC cadets perform a push-up for each Bearcats point during football games.
cards.evidence_claim: UC’s Red & Black Book says ROTC cadets do one push-up for every point scored by the Bearcats.
cards.source_title: The Red and Black Book — University of Cincinnati Student Alumni Council
cards.access_notes: A football-game tradition performed by ROTC cadets; spectators can observe and count along.

cards.title: Sing “Cheer Cincinnati”
cards.subtitle: Bearcats fight song
cards.notes: Use the official lyrics to follow the song at a game or spirit event, keeping pace with the band and crowd.
cards.short_summary: Cheer Cincinnati is UC’s documented Bearcats fight song and a gameday singalong.
cards.evidence_claim: UC’s Red & Black Book prints the lyrics to “Cheer Cincinnati” and identifies it among football gameday traditions.
cards.source_title: The Red and Black Book — University of Cincinnati Student Alumni Council
cards.access_notes: Commonly performed in athletics settings; follow the event program for timing.

cards.title: Stay for the Alma Mater
cards.subtitle: Postgame Bearcats tradition
cards.notes: At the end of a Bearcats game, remain through the closing song and sing along using UC’s published words.
cards.short_summary: UC’s student-alumni guide says a game is not over until the Alma Mater is sung.
cards.evidence_claim: The Red & Black Book says Bearcats fans stay until the end and that the game is not over until the Alma Mater is sung.
cards.source_title: The Red and Black Book — University of Cincinnati Student Alumni Council
cards.access_notes: Postgame tradition across Bearcats sports; timing depends on the event schedule.

cards.title: Watch the Walk Through at The Grid
cards.subtitle: Sigma Sigma Commons football pregame
cards.notes: Arrive early for the scheduled pregame walk-through and use the commons respectfully alongside the larger crowd.
cards.short_summary: The Grid tailgate brings together alumni and students before home football games.
cards.evidence_claim: UC’s Red & Black Book identifies the GRIDiron Tailgate on Sigma Sigma Commons before each home football game and notes the teams’ walk-through.
cards.source_title: The Red and Black Book — University of Cincinnati Student Alumni Council
cards.access_notes: Before home football games at Sigma Sigma Commons; check current gameday details for event arrangements.

cards.title: Wait for the First Basket
cards.subtitle: Fifth Third Arena basketball tradition
cards.notes: If materials are provided for the tradition, wait for the first Bearcats score and follow arena cleanup guidance.
cards.short_summary: The Red & Black Book documents a newspaper confetti toss after the first Bearcats basket.
cards.evidence_claim: UC’s Red & Black Book instructs students to use an old News Record for a confetti toss after the first Bearcats score at basketball games.
cards.source_title: The Red and Black Book — University of Cincinnati Student Alumni Council
cards.access_notes: At Fifth Third Arena basketball games; participate only as permitted by current arena staff and policies.

cards.title: Wear Red and Black on Friday
cards.subtitle: Weekly Bearcat spirit practice
cards.notes: Choose red-and-black Bearcat gear on Friday to take part in the campus spirit practice documented by UC students.
cards.short_summary: UC’s student-alumni guide describes Friday red-and-black Bearcat gear as a campus spirit practice.
cards.evidence_claim: The Red & Black Book says UC students wear Bearcat gear every Friday and encourages dressing in red and black.
cards.source_title: The Red and Black Book — University of Cincinnati Student Alumni Council
cards.access_notes: A Friday spirit practice, regardless of season; no event attendance is required.
